caption: The drawing depicts an aerial view of a formal garden and surrounding landscape, primarily rendered in green, beige, and other natural tones. The composition includes a large rectangular garden arranged with geometric precision near the center of the image, divided into multiple beds shaped as rectangles, triangles, and squares, each filled with colorful, patterned plantings in red, pink, green, and blue hues. Around the garden are several small, rectangular buildings shaded in light and dark gray. There are additional small plots with neat rows that appear to represent vegetable or flower beds to the upper left. The surrounding area features expanses of green-field lawns and clusters of individually rendered trees in different shades of green and brown. Yellow-beige roads or paths cut diagonally and horizontally across the scene, passing by the garden and buildings. In the upper right quadrant, a blue and gold heraldic coat of arms is shown, above the name “De Lancy,” and a helm and drapery rest above the shield. The entire scene is bordered by a plain beige background, and “Gilbert Sackerman” is signed at the lower left.
title: J. Delancey Estate
